answer: Time-locked answer challenge. Each identity must submit a freshly computed answer to a puzzle seeded by the current state of a shared garden of pending tasks, and the seed changes after every accepted submission. A vault stores only hashes of prior answers, so replaying a captured answer fails. A bridge contract timestamps each identity's last valid response and rejects submissions arriving faster than a fixed minimum interval. An attacker must run separate live computation for every identity, paying full compute plus delay per sybil, with no reuse of work.
